author: 爱奈丽+znq19
description: Know exactly where your tokens and your money go. Per-round logging (input/output/cached tokens, hit rate, latency) with live cost estimation — peak/off-peak rules, dual currency, and editing one rule re-prices all history instantly. Six-type API balance monitoring (auto-probe/custom/New-API/wallet/daily/rolling) with anchor calibration, plus threshold alerts on balance, tokens or cost. Check it four ways: WebUI dashboard with sparklines and trend drill-down, draggable floating widget, natural-language bot tools (can send a rendered overview image), custom commands.

zh.description: token 和钱花在哪，一清二楚。逐轮记录输入/输出/缓存 tokens、命中率与耗时，按峰谷价+双币种实时算钱——改一条价格规则，全部历史立即重算。6 类余额监测（自动探测/自定义接口/New-API/钱包扣减/每日重置/滚存积分）支持对表校准，余额·tokens·费用达阈值自动预警（可让 bot 主动开口告诉你）。四个入口随手看：WebUI 看板（KPI 走势 + 趋势下钻 + 会话级统计）、可拖动悬浮挂件、bot 自然语言问答（能直接发概览图）、自定义命令。
